assertions: The response routes across the python-api-modeling and prediction-fingerprints sub-skills.
The response builds data.MoleculeDataset from data.MoleculeDatapoint.from_smi datapoints.
The response wires nn.BondMessagePassing, nn.MeanAggregation and nn.RegressionFFN into a models.MPNN with metrics.
The response trains with a lightning.pytorch.Trainer and keeps the prediction loader with shuffle=False.
The response saves the model with chemprop.models.save_model including output_columns and mentions load_output_columns / load_model.
The response hands off to a chemprop predict command using the saved artifact as --model-path.
The response points to the bundled chemprop_api_smoke.py as a runnable CPU smoke script.
The response does not tell the user to open the original Chemprop source repository.
